# HardCall — 51.96ms (~52ms) 8kHz Raw RTP Voice Barge-In Gateway (https://hardcall.statementflow.win)

> Enterprise PSTN/SIP full-duplex voice agent infrastructure eliminating 920ms+ TCP/WebSocket double-talk collisions via raw 8kHz G.711 UDP/RTP (`ptime=20ms`), FreeSWITCH, `libsoxr` VHQ resampling, and a lock-free 256-frame outbound ring buffer (`0.16ms` flush).

## Verified 5-Stage Frame Budget (`51.96ms` p95 Cutoff vs `920ms` WebSocket)
- **Stage A (`20.00ms`)**: Inbound 8kHz G.711 PCMU/PCMA RTP Frame (`ptime=20ms`)
- **Stage B (`12.00ms`)**: Adaptive Carrier Jitter Buffer
- **Stage C (`1.80ms`)**: `libsoxr` VHQ `8kHz -> 16kHz` Phase-Linear Upsample
- **Stage D (`18.00ms`)**: Streaming Fast-Loop Speech Onset Gate
- **Stage E (`0.16ms`)**: 256-Frame Outbound RTP Ring-Buffer Flush & Drain
- **Total End-to-End Cutoff**: **`51.96ms` (`~52ms` p95)**

## Interactive Benchmarks & Open-Source Reference
- **8kHz PSTN Bandpass Voice Benchmark**: Hear `920ms` WebSocket double-talk overlap vs `51.96ms` Raw RTP cutoff on an automated insurance claims call (`https://hardcall.statementflow.win/#enterprise-b2b`).
- **Browser WebAudio Full-Duplex Barge-In Lab**: Live microphone RMS VU onset detector + 1-click caller interrupt comparing `Mode A: HardCall Raw RTP (52ms Flush)` vs `Mode B: Legacy WebSocket (920ms Tail Lag)` (`https://hardcall.statementflow.win/#simulator`).
- **Open-Source MIT RTP Lab**: `https://github.com/wangguode/ai-agent-voice/tree/main/01-voice-agent-rtp-bargein`
